events.verdict: Miller (CHA) firms up in Johnson's (ATL) path during the pick before both players briefly get tangled up as the screen concludes.
Johnson (ATL) legally contests Knueppel's (CHA) jump shot attempt.
McCollum (ATL) establishes himself in Bridges' (CHA) path and absorbs the contact during the dribble hand-off.
Diabate (CHA) maintains a legal guarding position and incidental contact occurs as he defends Johnson (ATL) during the drive.
Knueppel (CHA) legally contests McCollum's (ATL) jump shot attempt.
Okongwu (ATL) jumps toward the loose ball when marginal contact occurs with Diabate (CHA) during the rebound.
Knueppel (CHA) establishes himself in Alexander-Walker's (ATL) path, and marginal contact occurs when he releases away from the pick.
Alexander-Walker (ATL) legally contests Knueppel's (CHA) jump shot attempt.
Miller (CHA) briefly grasps Daniels' (ATL) right arm as he pursues the rebound, and the contact is marginal.
Diabate (CHA) is moving alongside Daniels' (ATL) path and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs during the drive.
Diabate (CHA) establishes himself and absorbs the initial body contact from Daniels (ATL) after his gather.
Johnson (ATL) and Knueppel (CHA) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Daniels (ATL) is moving alongside Ball's (CHA) path and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs during the drive.
Alexander-Walker (ATL) gets his hand directly to the ball to cleanly dislodge it from Ball (CHA) at the end of his drive.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Ball (CHA) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to Hawks (ATL).
Miller (CHA) dislodges Johnson (ATL) and delivers contact that drives Johnson (ATL) off their legally obtained screening position.
Okongwu (ATL) delivers contact to Ball (CHA) as he commits the take foul.
Knueppel (CHA) legally contests Alexander-Walker's (ATL) jump shot attempt.
Kispert (ATL) delivers contact to Miller's (CHA) arm as he commits the take foul.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on Miller (CHA) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Upon review, Alexander-Walker (ATL) was the last person to touch the ball before it went out of bounds. The possession is awarded to Charlotte.
Johnson (ATL) commits a take foul on Bridges (CHA).
